product: Anycubic Kobra 3 Max Purge Catcher — Interface Neuentwurf

scope.intended_use: Ein einteiliger, bodenloser Umlenker fährt fest mit dem Purge-Wiper entlang Z, fängt Filamentreste unmittelbar an der Quelle und leitet sie durch einen freien unteren Auslass nach unten. Die beiden vorhandenen Wiper-Schrauben befestigen den Umlenker direkt; es gibt weder Adapterplatte noch Clip oder Schnellverschluss.
scope.user_context: Betreiber eines Anycubic Kobra 3 Max; die konkrete Maschine ist durch eigene Fotos und Benutzermessungen dokumentiert. Serien-/Revisionskennung, Schraubenhardware und vollständige Maschinenhüllkurve bleiben unbekannt.
out_of_scope: Storage bin, floor, flap, clip, adapter plate, slider, latch or quick-release
Geometry, contours or dimensions derived from the third-party reference
Production release before physical interface and motion-envelope verification

entities.name: Anycubic Kobra 3 Max Purge-Wiper assembly and machine envelope
Two existing Wiper screws with unverified identity

interfaces.name: Direct fixed two-screw Wiper mount

coordinate_frame.origin: centre of the lower Wiper screw at the screw seating plane
coordinate_frame.x_positive: from the Wiper screw datum toward the purge impact wall
coordinate_frame.y_positive: toward the operator and printer front
coordinate_frame.z_positive: upward along the vertical screw pair

datums.description: Centre of lower existing Wiper screw
Centre of upper existing Wiper screw
Real printed-part seating plane under the two screw heads

constrained: all translation and rotation in use

assembly.direction: Align both integrated holes with the powered-off Wiper screw pair and tighten both verified screws through the printed body
assembly.contact_mode: fixed screw-clamped printed pads against the measured host seating surface
assembly.sequence_notes: No adapter, clip or quick-release; removal requires deliberate loosening of both screws. Confirm that screw engagement and Wiper alignment are not reduced.

dimensions.feature: Vertical centre-to-centre pitch of the two user-measured Wiper screws
Screw thread or shaft diameter and required printed-hole clearance
Screw-head diameter, height and printed seating geometry
Existing screw length, printed seating thickness and remaining thread engagement

loads_and_performance.target_status: project target, not a manufacturer-approved machine load

keepouts_and_access: Wiper shell and metal purge ledge
bed, rollers, print head and cable motion envelope
tool access to both screw heads

evidence.uncertainty_note: The 17 mm pitch and moving-side interface are supported by owned measurement evidence. Screw identity, head seat, seating thickness, remaining thread engagement, full host envelope and real coupon result remain unknown; no third-party contour or dimension is adopted.

failure_modes.mode: Hole pattern, head seat or printed mounting zone does not match the real Wiper interface
failure_modes.effect: The diverter cannot be installed, distorts the Wiper, loosens, cracks or detaches during machine motion
failure_modes.mitigation: Measure the real screws and seating interface, preserve solid load paths, and fit a cheap 17 mm hole-pattern and outline coupon before any full body.

failure_modes.mode: Printed seating thickness reduces screw engagement or changes Wiper alignment
failure_modes.effect: Original Wiper function or accessory retention becomes unreliable
failure_modes.mitigation: Record existing screw length, head geometry, host stack and required engagement; use verified replacement length only if necessary.

acceptance_criteria: An independently designed 17 mm hole-pattern and seating-thickness coupon fits both powered-off Wiper screws without forcing, bending or shifting the Wiper.
Thread, shaft, head diameter, head height, length under head, printed seating thickness and remaining thread engagement are recorded and accepted.
Both screws clamp the coupon and later the one-piece diverter directly; no adapter, clip, slider, latch or quick-release exists.

interfaces.name: Bottomless purge capture and gravity diversion

dimensions.feature: Lower Wiper screw centre to user-observed purge deposition plane
Screw datum to user-observed horizontal purge throw plane; exact endpoints and axis assignment remain to be confirmed
Minimum clear cross-section from impact zone through the fully open lower outlet

environment_and_variation.medium: warm, irregular and sometimes stringy filament remnants
environment_and_variation.storage: no storage floor or moving purge mass in the diverter

keepouts_and_access: No horizontal pocket, flap, floor or constriction in the downward flow path
Honeycomb and logo edges must remain outside the internal purge trajectory

evidence.uncertainty_note: The desired bottomless flow architecture and measured purge-related offsets are documented, but no approved new concept, geometry or low/mid/high-Z physical purge-cycle result exists.

failure_modes.mode: Purge misses the impact zone or catches on internal, honeycomb or logo edges
failure_modes.effect: Purge accumulates on the machine, obstructs the outlet or falls outside the intended path
failure_modes.mitigation: Keep the internal path smooth and bottomless, isolate decorative openings from the flow, and test representative purge cycles at low, middle and high Z.

acceptance_criteria: The CAD section contains no purge-bearing floor, flap, horizontal pocket or long closed channel.
At least three supervised purge cycles at each of low, middle and high Z enter the diverter and leave the open lower outlet without manual assistance or back-up.

interfaces.name: Moving diverter to complete machine keep-out envelope

dimensions.feature: User-observed screw-plane to rear Wiper extent; exact axis and bounding use require confirmation
Minimum verified clearance to Wiper, bed, rollers, print head and cables over the full motion and service sweep

keepouts_and_access: Wiper shell, metal ledge, rollers, bed, print head and cables

evidence.uncertainty_note: The prior model was rejected because its internally consistent datums did not represent the external machine envelope. Complete owned keep-outs and a real-machine outline coupon remain absent.

failure_modes.mode: The directly mounted diverter intersects an omitted stock part or motion envelope
failure_modes.effect: Machine collision, loss of function, accessory damage or property damage
failure_modes.mitigation: Derive an owned conservative outline from physical measurements, fit an outline coupon and complete a powered-off full-travel and tool-access sweep before any print-candidate claim.

acceptance_criteria: A clean-room outline and hole-pattern coupon fits the target machine without collision or forced installation.

The installed one-piece diverter, screw heads, tool access and service sweep retain at least 5 mm target clearance over the complete powered-off motion envelope unless a smaller documented clearance receives explicit human approval.

drivers: INT=3: Direct fastener, host-envelope and purge-medium boundaries govern fit and function.
MOT=2: The one-piece diverter co-moves with the Purge-Wiper along the guided Z translation.
PHY=3: Printed screw clamping, vibration, warm purge impact and gravity diversion require controlled physical tests.
VER=3: Hole-pattern, screw engagement, full motion, purge flow, mesh and slicer checks are all required.

blocking_unknowns: screw thread or shaft diameter, head diameter, head height, existing length, printed seating thickness and remaining thread engagement
owned complete machine envelope and a passing 17 mm hole-pattern plus outline coupon
approved concept and physical purge trajectory through the bottomless outlet

criticality.rationale: A fixed printed accessory moves with the printer and carries screw clamp load near the Wiper, bed, head and cables; detachment, collision or purge obstruction therefore requires controlled fit and functional testing.
credible_failure_effects: inability to install or loss of purge-diversion function
Wiper misalignment, loosening or printed mounting-zone fracture
machine collision, obstruction or minor property damage

decision.rationale: The user has selected a simple one-piece, bottomless, direct two-screw architecture and preserved the honeycomb/logo appearance. This is sufficient to review a clean-room concept after explicit requirements approval, but production CAD remains blocked until the actual screw contract and complete owned machine envelope pass coupon and motion checks.

warnings.message: Only the 17 mm screw pitch is independently measured. Screw diameter, head geometry, length, printed seating thickness and remaining engagement are still unknown.
The prior model was rejected because internal datum consistency did not prove external fit; an owned outline/keep-out coupon and powered-off full-motion check are still required.
The user-selected BY-NC 3MF may support qualitative side and mounting-principle observations only; its mesh, contours, dimensions, images and project metadata are excluded from the clean-room design.
The reference 3MF embeds a Bambu Lab P1S profile, not an Anycubic Kobra 3 Max manufacturing profile.

next_actions.action: Measure the two existing Wiper screws and the real seating stack, then build an owned 17 mm hole-pattern, seating-thickness and conservative outline coupon.
next_actions.exit_criterion: Thread or shaft diameter, head diameter, head height, length under head, printed seating thickness and remaining engagement are recorded, and the coupon fits without forcing, Wiper shift or collision.

next_actions.action: After explicit approval of requirements revision 0.7.0-requirements.5, create and review a clean-room concept sheet for the one-piece bottomless diverter with direct screw holes, open honeycomb walls and centred owned logo.
next_actions.exit_criterion: The owner explicitly approves the concept architecture and appearance; the image is treated as non-dimensional and uses no third-party geometry or dimensions.

next_actions.action: Verify complete machine motion, screw access and the bottomless purge path with the approved clean-room concept and later prototype.
next_actions.exit_criterion: Powered-off full-travel and service-sweep checks meet the clearance contract, and nine supervised low/middle/high-Z purge cycles exit freely without backlog.
